Name: Cozy Chocolate Walls and Floors (AT and CP)
Author: skellady
Description:
[center][img]https://imgur.com/tdKl4f5.png[/img]


[/center][img]https://imgur.com/Jl1E0ek.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]This mods adds 15+ walls and floors to match the theme of my Cozy Chocolate Furniture mod. Available for both Content Patcher and Alternative Textures.

For AT: Use the paint bucket on the wall/floor.
For CP: You can find the new wallpapers/floorings in the catalogue sold by Pierre that has all the vanilla wallpapers/floorings.

[img]https://imgur.com/cmP0vay.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] OR [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] (or both, you can run both versions together).
2. Install this mod.
3. Extract all and drop them into your Mods folder.[/size]
[/size]
[img]https://imgur.com/OYwortt.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]- [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS/about-me]Airyn[/url] and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MsHakunaMatata/about-me]HakunaMatata[/url] for helping out with the mod name.[/size]
